label: Primary Representative
description: Principal point of contact; may manage other entity users.

label: Authorized Representative
description: May act for the entity across submissions and correspondence.

label: Filing User
description: May prepare and submit filings for the entity.

label: Viewer
description: Read-only visibility of the entity's regulatory record.

label: Preparer
description: May prepare filings and respond to information requests, but may not make the final submission.
